scenario.title: Synthetic regional logistics continuity signal
scenario.instruction: Inspect the fixed synthetic evidence set through WF-01 to WF-11 and produce an evidence-linked analytical brief.

evidence.text: Three fictional operators report a two-day increase in transfer time.
A synthetic schedule records reduced capacity for the same bounded interval.
One fictional operator reports normal transfer time.
A fictional seasonal pattern can also affect transfer time.
An unattributed synthetic rumor is excluded from production-admitted evidence.
